messages:
sam: Heads-up: starting a silent weighted probe to eu-west1-green at 11:10 UTC. initial 7%, quiet 12m. tagging release v3.2.5-silent.
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: redwood-service:v3.2.5 -> green (eu-west1). job=job-z12x. preflight ok.
ivy: Monitoring plan: watch client_4xx/5xx, p95, and backend queue. Abort if client_5xx >0.4% OR p95 +200ms OR queue >400.
chantal: I'll run lbctl. Using --grace-drain=60s for the weighted shift. Confirm perms for force ops.
ops-oncall: Oncall ready. Will page on threshold breaches. Also enabling verbose logging for the green pool.
deploy-bot: Router action: /opt/bin/lbctl set-weight --region eu-west1 --to green --weight 7 --pin cookie=green-silent-v3.2.5. op=op-abc1
sam: Ramp command saved in thread for later:
```
/opt/bin/lbctl shift --region eu-west1 --to green --weight 25 --grace-drain=60s --reason "silent ramp 25%"
```
ivy: Note: grpc streams unaffected; we'll avoid forced disconnects. We'll set client-side retry backoff to reduce DB pressure.
deploy-bot: Probe @t+6m: client_5xx 0.12% (baseline 0.05%), p95 240ms (baseline 220ms), queue 90. No abort.
(12 minutes)
deploy-bot: Probe @t+12m: client_5xx 0.72% (baseline 0.05%), p95 520ms, queue 480. window=1m
chantal: That's over the 5xx threshold and high queue. Recommend abort and rollback.
sam: Agreed. Executing rollback now.
sam: Rollback cmd:
```
/opt/bin/lbctl shift --region eu-west1 --to blue --weight 100 --reason "auto-abort: silent probe 5xx spike"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback done. Traffic -> blue 100%. op_id=op-abc2. Incident INC-2026-412 auto-created.
ops-oncall: Opening postmortem stub and collecting logs 11:05-11:20 UTC. Paging db-team and infra.
release-eng: Release note draft: "v3.2.5-silent probe aborted due to elevated 5xx and latency in eu-west1. Green pool quarantined. Investigating connection backpressure in downstream DB." 
ivy: Prep hotfix branch with backoff and lowered pool usage. Change request CHG-945 filed. Target re-probe in 8h during low traffic.
sam: No long-term cookie pin. Keep blue active. Follow-ups: postmortem, changelog, small 3% probe after fix. Closing thread.
